inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2026E pro forma continuing revenue, not a reported figure. FY2025 reported 8,325 less Purification & Filtration 497 (10-K FY2025 segment table) = 7,828 continuing base. H1-26 actual 4,216; H2-26E = H2-25 ex-P&F 3,966 x ~1.01 (guided FY organic +2.5-3.0% implies roughly flat H2 organic after ERP advance orders reverse, plus ~1% FX/Acera) = ~4,010. FY2026E = ~8,225, +5.1% on the continuing base. Year 1 of the projection is FY2027.
inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted at 2026-06-30: 170.11M outstanding (10-Q cover/balance sheet, after 4.78M shares bought back in H1-26) + ~0.6M dilutive awards (Q2-26 diluted 173.3M vs basic 172.7M weighted). Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows, so buybacks are the cash mechanism that holds the count flat, not extra value.
inputs.debt_note: Short-term borrowings/current LTD 506 + long-term debt 4,573 + Eagan HQ finance lease 209 (new Mar-2026, 6.47%, through 2046) = 5,288; cash 403. 10-Q / Q2-26 earnings release balance sheet at 2026-06-30. The CSV TotalDebt (5,079) omits the finance lease.
inputs.last_fcf_note: FY2025 actual owner FCF (reported FCF -10 = OCF 369 - capex 379, less SBC 161). Not a run-rate: FY2025 OCF carries ~$111M transaction costs and taxes on the P&F sale, $600M+ of 3M separation/TSA-exit spend and loses four months of P&F. FY2026 guided FCF is $200-300M on the same one-offs. The projection is built from components, not from this base.
inputs.sbc_source: 10-K FY2025 cash flow statement, 'Stock-based compensation expense' 161 (FY2024 112, FY2023 39 carve-out allocation). Equity-award tax withholding is immaterial (~$12M in the H1-26 equity statement) and not added. Solventum's adjusted operating income does NOT add back SBC, so SBC is inside the adjusted margins it guides.
inputs.buyback_note: H1-2026 purchases of treasury stock $355M (4.78M shares) under the $1B Nov-2025 authorization; zero in FY2025. The company is a real repurchaser, so the flat count is funded.
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, USD rate. Cost of equity ~9.3% (10y UST ~4.3% + beta ~1.0 x 5.0% ERP); after-tax cost of debt ~4.4% (BBB- on positive watch, ~5.6% pre-tax, 21% tax). Market weights ~76/24 (market cap ~$15.0B vs net debt ~$4.9B) -> ~8.1%; rounded up to 8.25% for spin-off execution and unquantified PFAS exposure. Same WACC in every scenario; scenario risk is carried in the driver paths and weights, not a rate premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: US GAAP: operating-lease cost sits inside SG&A/COGS and therefore inside the EBITDA margin, so operating-lease liabilities are NOT added to debt. The one finance lease (Eagan HQ, $209M) is debt and its ROU depreciation is in D&A.
inputs.nci_treatment: None; Solventum has no material non-controlling interests.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon (FY2027-FY2036), three scenarios. Solventum is a US med-tech operating company (MedSurg 64%, Dental 18%, Health Information Systems 17% of FY26 H1 segment sales), so it routes to owner-FCF; none of the non-FCF rows apply. Special treatment taken for the spin/divestiture/leverage: (1) FY0 is a PRO FORMA continuing-operations FY2026E revenue base excluding Purification & Filtration (sold to Thermo Fisher 2025-09-01); the Q3-2025 $1,266M net income / $1,690M operating income is the $1,549M pre-tax gain on that sale and is ignored entirely. (2) Margins are built from Solventum's ADJUSTED operating margin (which excludes intangible amortization, restructuring, 3M separation, litigation, P&F separation, Acera integration and HIS-separation costs) MINUS an explicit cash charge for those 'special' items, stepping down from ~5% of sales in FY2027 (separation tail, Transform for the Future restructuring ~$500M over four years, HIS separation) to a permanent ~1.5% (recurring litigation/PFAS and restructuring) from FY2030. The company's adjusted figures are therefore NOT taken at face value: in H1-26 the specials were $577M on $4.2B of sales (GAAP 6.2% vs adjusted 24.2% margin). (3) Leverage enters once, through net debt at the 2026-06-30 balance sheet (incl. the finance lease), with an equity bridge for the after-tax pension deficit and the after-tax accrued litigation balance; the H2-FY2026 owner FCF (guidance midpoint less H1 actual, less H2 SBC) is added because year 1 of the projection is FY2027. (4) Amortization of acquired intangibles is non-cash and excluded from EBIT for tax only via D&A = depreciation; its tax shield is not credited (conservative; much of the 3M-carryover basis is not separately deductible). (5) The intended HIS separation (announced 2026-08-05, pathway undecided) is NOT modelled as a transaction; the company is valued whole. A spin is value-neutral to this model apart from dis-synergies; a sale at a premium would be upside. Buybacks: $355M in H1-26 against a $1B authorization; value-neutral under the flat-count convention. PFAS: 3M's indemnity for Solventum product PFAS claims lapsed after 2025; no PFAS liability is accrued and it is carried in the bear case's higher recurring special-items charge and lower exit multiple, not as a point estimate.
inputs.sanity_multiples_note: For multiples cross-checks use adjusted figures: FY2026 guided adjusted EPS $7.10-7.20 -> ~12.3x P/E at the current price; EV ~$20.3B (market cap ~$15.0B + net debt $4.9B + pension) on FY2026E adjusted EBITDA ~ $1.95B (adj. op income ~21.5% x 8,225 + depreciation ~180) -> ~10.4x. GAAP P/E (FY2025 EPS $8.94, incl. the P&F gain; TTM GAAP ~$8.3) is not meaningful.

equity_bridge.item: Pension and postretirement deficit, after tax
equity_bridge.note: Balance sheet 2026-06-30 'Pension and postretirement benefits' 358 x (1 - 21%)

10-Q Q2-26 Note 12: accrued litigation costs $235M at 2026-06-30 (from $31M at Dec-25 after a $204M Q2 legal charge) x (1 - 21%). May overlap with H2 FCF guidance if settled in 2026 - deducted anyway (conservative).

FY2026 FCF guidance midpoint $250M less H1-26 actual -$129M = ~$379M H2 levered FCF, less ~$89M H2 SBC. Needed because the explicit projection starts at FY2027 and the 2026-06-30 balance sheet only reflects H1.

historical_growth.revenue_continuing_note: FY2022 8,130 -> FY2025 8,325 reported (includes P&F). Organic growth FY2025 +3.3%, FY2024 ~+0.5-1% (10-K). No 5-year revenue history: FY2021 carve-out has equity only.
historical_growth.eps_note: FY2022 7.78 -> FY2025 8.94 is meaningless: FY2022 is a carve-out with no interest burden and FY2025 contains the $1,549M P&F gain. FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance $7.10-7.20 is the usable anchor.
historical_growth.equity_note: FY2022 11,742 -> FY2025 5,049: the drop is the ~$8.3B of spin-off debt pushed onto Solventum and the cash distributed to 3M at separation, not value destruction. Book value is not a growth signal here.
historical_growth.fcf_note: Owner FCF (reported FCF - SBC): FY2022 1,391, FY2023 1,586, FY2024 693, FY2025 -171. Pre-spin carve-out years carry no interest, no standalone costs and allocated SBC; post-spin years carry separation/TSA-exit spend, interest ~$350M and P&F sale taxes. A CAGR across a sign change is undefined and would describe the separation, not the business. SBC rose from $37M (allocated) to $161M - a standalone-company step-up, not compounding.
historical_growth.growth_rate_source: Organic sales growth: FY2025 +3.3% (10-K), FY2026 guidance +3.5-4.0% excluding ~100bps SKU exits (+2.5-3.0% reported organic). Equity CAGR is rejected as the primary anchor because the spin-off debt push-down makes it -24.5%.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3-yr CAGR (-24.5%) diverges by far more than 30% from revenue (+0.8%) and EPS (+4.7%) CAGRs. Cause: carve-out-to-standalone transition (spin debt, separation costs) and the 2025 P&F divestiture. All historical CAGRs are distorted; the base case is anchored on organic growth and guidance instead.
historical_growth.notes: Every historical series straddles the April-2024 spin from 3M and the September-2025 P&F sale. Use FY2025 organic growth (+3.3%), H1-2026 organic (+5.8%, flattered by ERP advance orders) and FY2026 guidance as the forward anchors.

base.ebitda_margin_note: Pre-SBC EBITDA after cash special items = (adjusted EBITA margin - special items) + depreciation + SBC. Adjusted EBITA: 22.0 / 22.75 / 23.25 / 23.5 flat (FY2026 guide 21-21.5%; Transform for the Future targets ~$500M gross savings by ~2029, a portion reinvested). Special items: 5.0 / 3.25 / 2.25 / 1.5 permanent. So EBITA after specials 17.0 / 19.5 / 21.0 / 22.0.
base.da_note: Depreciation only (FY2025 489 D&A less 312 amortization = 177, 2.1% of sales; H1-26 87, 2.1%). Rises as the separation capex (own plants replacing 3M supply) enters service, converging on ~3.2% against 3.6% maintenance-plus-growth capex.
base.capex_note: FY2024 380 / FY2025 379 (4.6%) inflated by separation capex; H1-26 167 (4.0%). Normalising to 3.6% by FY2031.
base.tax_note: Adjusted ETR ~20% (H1-26 20.3%); cash rate held at 21% on EBIT.
base.wc_note: Manufacturer: receivables 1,310 + inventory 1,040 - payables 701 - unearned revenue 596 = ~1,050 net, ~12.5% of sales. Growth consumes cash.
base.narrative: Organic growth of ~3.5-4% in MedSurg and Dental with HIS growing low-single-digit, adjusted EBITA margin expanding from ~21.5% to 23.5% as Transform for the Future savings land, separation costs roll off by FY2029 and only a ~1.5% permanent special-items charge remains.

bull.ebitda_margin_note: EBITA after specials 18.0 / 21.0 / 23.0 / 24.0 / 24.5 (adjusted ~25.5% less 1.0% specials) + the same depreciation and SBC paths as base.

bear.ebitda_margin_note: EBITA after specials 15.0 / 16.5 / 17.5 / 18.0 / 18.5 (adjusted stuck at ~21% as savings are reinvested or competed away, less a permanent 2.5% for PFAS and product litigation now unindemnified) + base depreciation and SBC.

scenario_narratives.base: Solventum finishes the 3M separation on plan: TSA exits and ERP cutovers complete through 2027, the ~$500M Transform for the Future cost programme lifts adjusted EBITA margin from the guided ~21.5% to ~23.5% by FY2030, and MedSurg (advanced wound care incl. Acera, infection prevention) and Dental compound ~3.5-4% organically while HIS grows low-single-digit against AI-native coding competition. Special items fall from ~$600M+/yr today to a permanent ~1.5% of sales for litigation and ongoing restructuring. Leverage drifts to ~2x net debt/EBITDA, freeing cash for the buyback; the HIS separation is value-neutral.
scenario_narratives.bull: Separation savings come through at the top of the range and stick, taking adjusted EBITA to ~25.5% (closer to wound-care/dental peers) with only ~1% recurring specials; the H1-2026 organic acceleration (+5.8%, strong in Advanced Wound Care and Dental) proves more durable than the ERP pull-forward explanation, Acera's synthetic tissue matrices scale, and an HIS separation crystallises a software multiple for the slower asset. Growth runs ~4.5-5% through FY2031 and the market re-rates a deleveraged, investment-grade-upgraded med-tech to ~17x owner FCF at exit.
scenario_narratives.bear: The standalone cost base proves structurally higher than 3M's allocation: savings are reinvested or competed away by Smith & Nephew/ConvaTec in wound care and Align/Envista in dental, adjusted EBITA stalls near 21%, and HIS loses share to Microsoft/Nuance, Epic and Optum autonomous coding. With 3M's PFAS indemnity lapsed after 2025, product-PFAS and other litigation becomes a permanent ~2.5%-of-sales cash drain (the Q2-26 $204M legal charge is the first sign). Organic growth falls to ~2%, leverage stays ~3x and limits buybacks, and the exit multiple compresses to 12x.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25%: newly unindemnified PFAS exposure with no accrual, a fresh $204M litigation charge, and an HIS separation stacked on an unfinished 3M separation are concrete, company-specific downside paths. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs several independent things to go right at once (full savings capture, durable organic acceleration, HIS crystallisation and a re-rating). Base 50%: guidance has been raised twice in 2026 and deleveraging is ahead of plan.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the continuing business (MedSurg, Dental, HIS) on owner FCF after SBC and after every recurring 'special' cash cost, not on Solventum's adjusted metrics. The Q3-2025 P&F gain and the four months of P&F in FY2025 are excluded; the $4B sale proceeds already sit in the lower 2026-06-30 net debt. The valuation is mostly a margin-normalisation question: how much of the ~13-point gap between adjusted and GAAP operating margin in 2026 is genuinely temporary.
key_risks_to_valuation: Special items do not roll off: each 1pp of permanent special-items charge is worth roughly $6-7/share in the base case.
PFAS: 3M's indemnity for Solventum product claims lapsed after 2025; no liability is accrued and the exposure is unquantified.
HIS separation: execution cost and dis-synergies, or a sale below the value this model implicitly assigns the segment.
Leverage: ~$4.9B net debt (~2.6x FY2026E adjusted EBITDA) makes equity value sensitive to margin misses and refinancing rates.
FY2026 includes one-offs (IEEPA tariff refund, ERP advance orders) that flatter H1; the FY2027 starting margin assumes these do not repeat.
